name: Alex Pereira
profileSummary: Alex Sandro Silva Pereira is a Brazilian professional mixed martial artist and former professional kickboxer. He currently competes in the Heavyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), he is the former two-time UFC Light Heavyweight Champion and former UFC Middleweight Champion. As of 20 June 2026, he is #1 in the Meta UFC light heavyweight rankings, #4 in the Meta UFC heavyweight rankings and as of 14 July 2026, he is #9 in the UFC men's pound-for-pound rankings.
